# The Grounds by Aldar (full)

> Independent marketing site at thegrounds.ae for The Grounds by Aldar, a vitality-led master community in Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO), developed by Aldar with Dubai Holding. Approximately 1,800 homes: 3 and 4 bed townhouses, twin villas and villas. Guide starting price AED 2.85M (3-bed townhouse). Expected sales launch December 2026.

## About this site

Static HTML site with local fonts and media (no hotlinked third-party assets). Google Tag Manager container GTM-KSW89QM7. Registration uses a modal form (full name, email, UAE phone +971, broker/buyer role, message); it does not reserve property.

## Guide prices (indicative)

| Home | Guide from (AED) |
|------|------------------|
| 3-bedroom townhouse | 2,850,000 |
| 4-bedroom townhouse | 3,500,000 |
| 4-bedroom twin villa | 3,950,000 |
| 3-bedroom villa | 4,100,000 |
| 4-bedroom villa | 4,800,000 to 4,900,000 |

Entry price per sq. ft.: about AED 1,400 (3-bedroom townhouse, about 2,040 sq. ft.). Townhouse areas: about 2,040 sq. ft. (3 bed) and 2,200 sq. ft. (4 bed). Villa areas are released at launch.

## Payment plan (quoted ahead of launch)

5% on booking, 45% during construction, 50% on handover. Exact schedule confirmed by Aldar in the sale agreement. No post-handover plan announced. Dubai Land Department fee generally 4% of the price; Oqood registration fee applies.

| Home | Guide price | 5% booking | 45% construction | 50% handover |
|------|-------------|------------|------------------|--------------|
| 3-bedroom townhouse | AED 2,850,000 | AED 142,500 | AED 1,282,500 | AED 1,425,000 |
| 4-bedroom townhouse | AED 3,500,000 | AED 175,000 | AED 1,575,000 | AED 1,750,000 |
| 4-bedroom twin villa | AED 3,950,000 | AED 197,500 | AED 1,777,500 | AED 1,975,000 |
| 3-bedroom villa | AED 4,100,000 | AED 205,000 | AED 1,845,000 | AED 2,050,000 |
| 4-bedroom villa | AED 4,800,000 | AED 240,000 | AED 2,160,000 | AED 2,400,000 |

## Key facts

- Developer: Aldar, in partnership with Dubai Holding
- Location: Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO), east Dubai, beside Dubai International Academic City; served by Al Ain Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road; Dubai Metro Blue Line Silicon Oasis station scheduled for 9 September 2029
- Homes: about 1,800 townhouses, twin villas and standalone villas
- Expected sales launch: first week of December 2026
- Indicated completion: Q2 2030
